name: patent-infringement-analysis
description: Drafts patent infringement and non-infringement analyses with element-by-element claim charts for U.S. utility patents, for the patent owner or accused party. Confirms the claim text in force after reexamination, IPR or reissue, patent term, terminal disclaimer and maintenance status; construes claims under Phillips from the claim language, specification and file history; tests 112(f) means-plus-function and nonce terms under Williamson; applies the all-elements rule; tests equivalents against vitiation, Festo prosecution history estoppel and dedication; charts method claims and divided infringement under Akamai; tests inducement and contributory infringement for knowledge under Global-Tech and Commil; checks 271(f) and (g) extraterritorial acts, the 286 six-year window, 287 marking, IPR estoppel and willfulness facts. Use for claim chart, infringement analysis, non-infringement position, design-around review or notice letter response. Not an opinion of counsel; routes damages to expert-report-on-damages.
